_comment: Endpoints the client must reach at 127.0.0.1:8080 (the embedded reTB Host server). Every replacement is shorter than the original: the patcher rewrites the IL2CPP literal length so the runtime reads exactly the new string.

manifest_removals._comment: Google Mobile Ads init provider: useless offline, initialises at process start. The known-good build removes it.

The only ad UI the SDK can launch. Offline there is never fill, so nothing can open it; dropping the declaration means an ad can never put its WebView in front of the game. The APPLICATION_ID meta-data stays: the SDK reads it if the game's rewarded-video path ever initialises, and a missing id throws instead of failing gracefully.
